title: design-system.yml: the privileged publish job keeps ${{ out of its run scripts, pins setup-node at v7.1.0, and refuses any tarball that is not exactly one @concepttocloud/saiku-design-system package matching the build's version

criteria.given: the publish job of .github/workflows/design-system.yml (the only job holding id-token: write)
criteria.then: no run: script in that job contains the ${{ expression syntax — build output reaches them through env, never interpolated into the script text

criteria.given: a tarball downloaded from the unprivileged build job into pkg/
criteria.then: a credential-free gate step runs before Publish: exactly one *.tgz, its own package/package.json naming @concepttocloud/saiku-design-system at a strict-semver version equal to the build's reported version; Publish then publishes exactly that verified tarball, not the pkg/*.tgz glob
it is pinned at the v7.1.0 commit SHA (949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1), the same pin the build job and the rest of the repository use since #2399

criteria.given: the build job's npm pack step
criteria.then: it creates the pack destination first (mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/pack") before npm pack, so a clean checkout cannot fail with ENOENT (the regression #2369 fixed)
